plugins.name: Close Apps While Gaming
plugins.author: tago
plugins.description: Closes programs you pick when a game starts, and opens them again afterwards. Windows only.
plugins.details: Frees up memory and CPU for the game. List the programs in this plugin's options, like chrome.exe, Spotify.exe. They're asked to close normally, the same as clicking X, unless you turn on force closing. Programs that hide in the tray instead of closing, like Discord, need force closing. They reopen when the last game started from Ascendara closes.
affects: Closes and reopens the programs you list around play sessions

settings.label: Force close
settings.description: Unsaved work in these programs is lost.

settings.label: Reopen them when the game closes

plugins.name: Compact Mode
plugins.author: tago
plugins.description: Makes text, spacing and game cards smaller so more fits on screen.
plugins.details: Useful on small or low-resolution screens. Pick how compact in this plugin's options. A few fixed-size parts, like the title bar, keep their size.
affects: Scales down text, spacing and cards across Ascendara

plugins.name: DS4Windows
plugins.author: tago
plugins.description: Makes PlayStation controllers work in games that only support Xbox controllers. Windows only.
plugins.details: Many games only read Xbox controllers. Steam fixes this for its own games with Steam Input, but games started from Ascendara don't get it, so a DualShock 4 or DualSense does nothing in them. This plugin starts DS4Windows when a game starts, which shows your PlayStation controller to games as an Xbox controller, and closes it again when the last game closes. DS4Windows is downloaded from its GitHub releases the first time it's needed. The first time it runs, DS4Windows asks to install the ViGEmBus driver: click Install in its welcome window, then start the game again. DS4Windows also needs the .NET 8 Desktop Runtime, and Windows offers to download it if it's missing. Already have DS4Windows? Set its path in this plugin's options.
affects: Starts DS4Windows while a game is running, and closes it afterwards
Downloads DS4Windows the first time a game starts

settings.label: Run DS4Windows
settings.description: While Ascendara is open, Big Picture may see your controller twice. Turn on "Hide DS4 Controller" in DS4Windows to fix that.

options.label: Only while a game is running

settings.label: Use my own DS4Windows
settings.description: Full path to DS4Windows.exe. Leave empty to have the plugin download it.

plugins.name: DXVK
plugins.author: tago
plugins.description: Install DXVK into a game from its Manage menu, to fix stutter and crashes in older games. Windows only.
plugins.details: DXVK runs Direct3D 8, 9, 10 and 11 games on Vulkan. It often fixes stutter, crashes and low frame rates in older games, especially on AMD and Intel graphics. Pick the game's Direct3D version and whether it's 32 or 64-bit in this plugin's options, then use "Install DXVK" on the game's page. Files the game already had are backed up, and "Remove DXVK" puts them back. DXVK is downloaded from its official GitHub releases the first time it's used. Needs a graphics card with Vulkan support. Don't use it in online games with anti-cheat.
affects: Adds "Install DXVK" and "Remove DXVK" to the Manage menu
Copies DXVK's DLLs into the game's folder when you install it

settings.label: The game's Direct3D version
settings.description: Check the game's store page or PCGamingWiki if you're not sure.

plugins.name: Gaming Power Plan
plugins.author: tago
plugins.description: Switches Windows to High performance while you play, then back. Windows only.
plugins.details: Laptops and power-saving plans can hold the CPU back in games. While a game started from Ascendara is running, this switches to the power plan you pick, and goes back to your usual plan when the last game closes. Ultimate Performance only exists if it was added to Windows, and other plans can be picked by their GUID.
affects: Changes the Windows power plan while a game is running

settings.label: Or use this power plan GUID
settings.description: For other plans. Run "powercfg /list" in a terminal to see their GUIDs.

plugins.name: Hide Ascend
plugins.author: tago
plugins.description: Removes the Ascend button from the navigation bar.
plugins.details: For anyone who doesn't use Ascend and wants a cleaner navigation bar. Only the button is hidden, so Ascend itself keeps working.
affects: Hides the Ascend button in the navigation bar

plugins.name: Hide Title Bar Badges
plugins.author: tago
plugins.description: Choose which badges show next to the Ascendara name, like "Torrenting is enabled - use VPN".
plugins.details: Pick the badges to hide in this plugin's options. They come back when the plugin is turned off. Only the badges are hidden: torrenting, Big Picture and everything else keep working. Update and connection badges always stay visible.
affects: Hides the title bar badges you choose

settings.label: Hide "Torrenting is enabled - use VPN"
settings.description: Using a VPN is still recommended while torrenting.

plugins.name: Hide Navigation Items
plugins.author: tago
plugins.description: Choose which buttons show in the navigation bar.
plugins.details: Pick the buttons to hide in this plugin's options, for a shorter navigation bar. Only the buttons are hidden: the pages keep working. Home and Settings always stay visible so you can't lock yourself out.
affects: Hides the navigation bar buttons you choose

plugins.name: Hide Store Card Details
plugins.author: tago
plugins.description: Choose what game cards in Search show, like ratings, views or tags.
plugins.details: For a cleaner store. Pick the details to hide in this plugin's options. The game page still shows everything.
affects: Hides the game card details you choose in Search

settings.label: Hide DLC, online and story labels
Hide size, version and update date

plugins.name: Save Folder
plugins.author: tago
plugins.description: Adds "Open save folder", "Set save folder" and "Copy executable path" to a game's Manage menu.
plugins.details: Finds where a game keeps its saves: the folder you set with "Set save folder" first, then Ludusavi's save locations from PCGamingWiki, then the places cracks keep saves by Steam App ID (GSE Saves, Goldberg, CODEX, RUNE, OnlineFix, EMPRESS and others). A folder you set is also used by Save Backups and Ludusavi backups. Handy for backing up saves by hand or moving them between PCs.
affects: Adds up to four items to the Manage menu on a game's page
Set save folder saves the folder in the game's Ascendara data
plugins.changelog: Looks up save locations with Ludusavi, and adds Set save folder and Reset save folder for when the folder found is wrong.

plugins.name: Pause Downloads While Playing
plugins.author: tago
plugins.description: Pauses game downloads while you play, and resumes them when you stop.
plugins.details: Downloading in the background can cause lag in online games and stutter while the disk is busy. When a game started from Ascendara launches, running downloads are paused. They resume when the last running game closes. Downloads you paused yourself are left alone.
affects: Pauses and resumes your game downloads around play sessions

settings.label: Resume downloads when the game closes

plugins.name: Run With
plugins.author: tago
plugins.description: Start games through another program, like a mod launcher or injector.
plugins.details: Set the program and its arguments in this plugin's options, and "Run with ..." appears in every game's Manage menu. In the arguments, {exe} becomes the game's executable and {dir} its folder, for example: --launch "{exe}". Playtime and the game's running state aren't tracked when a game is started this way.
affects: Adds "Run with ..." to the Manage menu on a game's page

settings.label: Program
settings.description: Full path to the program that starts the game.

settings.label: Arguments
settings.description: {exe} is the game's executable, {dir} its folder.

settings.label: Menu name
settings.description: Shown as "Run with <name>". Leave empty to use the program's name.

settings.label: Start in the program's folder instead of the game's

plugins.name: Save Backups
plugins.author: tago
plugins.description: Backs up a game's saves every time it closes, and keeps the newest copies.
plugins.details: When a game closes, its save folder is zipped into this plugin's folder. The save folder is the one set with the Save Folder plugin's "Set save folder", or else found with Ludusavi's save locations and the game's Steam App ID. Use "Open save backups" in a game's Manage menu to get to the backups, and unzip one into the save folder to restore it. Uses the tar program built into Windows 10 and newer, macOS and Linux.
affects: Copies save folders into this plugin's folder when a game closes
Adds "Back up saves now" and "Open save backups" to the Manage menu
plugins.changelog: Backs up the save folder you set, and finds more save folders through Ludusavi (Ascendara 12.3.5 and newer).

settings.label: Show a message after each automatic backup

plugins.name: Session Timer
plugins.author: tago
plugins.description: Reminds you to take a break after playing for a while.
plugins.details: Shows a reminder once a game has been running for the time you pick, and optionally again at the same interval. When the game closes, it can also say how long you played. Only games started from Ascendara are timed.
affects: Shows break reminders while a game started from Ascendara is running

settings.label: Keep reminding at the same interval
Say how long I played when the game closes
